operations.name: debit
operations.spec: sets the source account balance to its previous balance minus amount using Nat subtraction (saturating at zero)

operations.name: credit
operations.spec: increases the destination account balance by amount

operations.name: audit
operations.spec: records an audit code without changing the bank state

laws.name: transfer_preserves_total
laws.statement: debit followed by credit preserves total bank balance

observations.name: balanceOf
observations.spec: reads an account balance from the selected Bank state
